about: The one browser that draws the picture cards (docs/runbooks/card-images.md): Chrome for Testing headless shell, the build playwright-core 1.63.0 is made for (chromium-headless-shell v1243). Installed by node tools/cards/install-chromium.mjs, which checks the size and SHA-256 below before unpacking. A different build may draw different pixels: change this only with a full re-render (node tools/cards/render.mjs --write).
